units: 1080x1920 pixels and seconds; frame counts refer to 30 fps delivery
status: Editorial starting values, not empirically proven viral settings

presets.purpose: Move toward the detail that proves the narrated claim
Change context while preserving a recognizable object across the cut
rules: Reuse the same cutout or matched geometry
A meaningful context change must occur

presets.purpose: Expose a hidden mechanism behind a surface
rules: Move the foreground surface or reveal mask
Treat the reveal as information, not a full-screen wipe

presets.purpose: Move from exterior to the mechanism inside the same object
rules: Show the causal connection after opening it

presets.purpose: Identify the exact evidence point without competing with the visual
rules: Track the anchor in screen space
Validate label bounds after camera movement

presets.purpose: Emphasize one narrated word or phrase
Place a paper object with weight and then let it rest
rules: Only where a placement action occurs
Contact shadow must agree with elevation
No perpetual sway on every object

presets.purpose: Move attention from context to the evidence detail
rules: One focal subject at a time

presets.purpose: Make a change verifiable on a shared scale
rules: Use sourced values, not generated chart art

presets.purpose: A single directional turn at a genuine narrative twist
rules: Follow a visible direction or object
Do not use as the default transition
